decisions.quote: In the UK alone, AI startups raised $12.6 billion in the first half of 2026, more than four times the total for the same period last year, according to HSBC.
decisions.reason: 原文为英国AI初创企业2026年上半年的融资总额统计，不是名为UK AI startups的企业，也不是单笔融资；只移除此错误融资Claim，保留原文和其他独立候选。

decisions.quote: BOB AI Holdings Corp. ("BOB"), the AI finance employee for small business, today announced it has raised $5.5 million in seed funding.
decisions.reason: 原文首段明确命名融资主体BOB AI Holdings Corp.，括号简称BOB；Miami是地点，Startup是标题描述。仅修正当前来源融资Claim，不批准规范实体合并。

decisions.quote: The round was led by Scaleup Europe Fund, managed by EQT, with participation from WIL (World Innovation Lab), existing investors including Greenoaks, ICONIQ, IVP, and Meritech, and a planned investment from NVIDIA.
decisions.reason: planned investment 不等于已完成参投；保留原文和卡片风险说明。

decisions.quote: SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Blacksmith, the infrastructure platform for building and testing code, today announced a $66M Series C led by Sequoia Capital at a $1 billion valuation, with participation from Premji Invest and existing investors Peak XV Partners, GV and Y Combinator.
decisions.reason: 原文为同一Blacksmith于2026-10-21宣布的6600万美元C轮，Sequoia领投；与既有已发布C轮一致。合并来源并保留既有C轮ID与独立B轮，仅展示去重，不审批规范实体合并。
融资主体已修正；独立研究来源数量不足，保留research_sources_insufficient及原文，不强行准入。
